column5: GROUP: **Stage 04** | - `S04/conformance.rs:253-258, 338-340`: calls skipped. `:444-446, 534`: an elided selection whose inferred lifetimes disagree is skipped with no diagnostic. `:850-854, 863-865`: bindings not visited.
